_source: Manually curated from https://untappd.com/blog's 'New Badge: X' posts - these are Untappd's own time-limited promotional badges, never in the permanent badges.untappd.com catalog (badge_beer_categories.json/badge_venue_categories.json), so they have to be read and re-catalogued by hand whenever a new one is announced. Checked live 2026-11-23 - entries are ACTIVE-or-UPCOMING as of that date (activeUntil >= today). The only entry this file held, 'Untappd Check-In Challenge: Week 3 Badge (2026)' (activeUntil 2026-11-22), has now expired and was pruned, leaving this list empty; special_badges_pending_review.json's Season-1 note was updated to match. No new 'New Badge' posts were found since the prior 2026-11-17 check (Bar Fly, Amaro Day, Champagne Day, Mezcal Day, Gin & Tonic Day, Scream-Worthy Hard Cider, Liqueur Day, Pumpkin Beer Season, Barrel-Aged Beer Day, Untappd 16th Anniversary, International Stout Day are all already-handled posts from earlier checks). Week 4 of the Check-In Challenge unlocks today (2026-11-23) per its own Season-1 schedule, but no 'Untappd Check-In Challenge: Week 4' post existed on the blog as of this check - re-check once it's published. New posts whose criteria this schema can't compute (brewery-specific, venue-location, or otherwise ambiguous) are logged in special_badges_pending_review.json instead of guessed here. Re-check the blog periodically (no feed/API for this - it's a real page read each time) and prune entries whose activeUntil has passed, same way this list was built.
